newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rates fall slightly at auction.

text.p: Mexican government 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.1 of a percentage point to 1.02 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 364-day Bondes were assigned at 99.06961 pesos.
Demand for the one-year Bondes was 2.465 billion pesos compared to the 500 million offered by Banco de Mexico.
The rate on the 728-day Bondes fell 0.09 percentage points to 1.17 percent above the one-month Cetes rate.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 98.06695 pesos.
Demand for the 728-day Bondes was 2.671 billion pesos compared to the 700 million offered by Banco de Mexico.
